title: 第292章 从未用过的底牌第291章 雷法与武道结合
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
“他居然打伤了龙君？”
这一刻，无论是谁，都目瞪口呆。
那些先前还在嘲讽顾铮不自量力的宾客，此刻张大了嘴巴，半天合不拢。那些摇头叹息、认定顾铮必死无疑的人，此刻面面相觑，眼中满是难以置信的神色。
就连敖言溪一行人，也满是不可置信。
青青捂住了嘴，胡姨的眉头紧锁，林文和林武对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了震惊。敖煜更是咽了咽口水，背后冒出一层冷汗，他想起自己当初和顾铮切磋时那点可怜的骄傲，若是顾铮当时用出这一招，他现在恐怕连灰都不剩了。
“这一战，顾铮虽败犹荣……”有人低声喃喃道。
双方的实力差距摆在那里。
一个是即将化龙的蛟龙，一个是连混元境都不到的人类。.
能伤龙君到这种地步，已经足以让天下人对这个年轻人刮目相看。
然而，就在所有人都以为这场战斗将以顾铮的“虽败犹荣”告终时，
昂！！！
一声痛苦的龙吟响彻天地之间，震得整座白波湖的湖水都翻涌沸腾！
龙君仰天长啸，声音中带着愤怒、带着兴奋、带着一股被压抑了太久终于要释放的狂暴！
“顾铮！！！你很好！！！”龙君低下头，目光如炬地盯着顾铮，声音如同雷霆滚滚，“只可惜，你赢不了我！！！”
他动了。
这是龙君在这场战斗中第一次主动出手。
他一步踏出，整座广场都在他的脚下震颤开裂，一股排山倒海般的威压朝着顾铮碾压而去！
所有人都清楚，龙君一旦认真起来，这场战斗就没有悬念了。
双方的约定是顾铮在他手下撑过一炷香的时间，而现在，才过了十分之一都不到。
所有人都认为，只要龙君出手，顾铮必败无疑。

“顾铮！！”敖言溪忍不住出声喊道，声音中带着掩饰不住的焦急。
然而，顾铮淡然的声音却在她耳畔响起，平静得仿佛只是在陈述一件微不足道的小事：“莫担心。”
龙君出手了。
他五指成爪，朝着顾铮凌空一握！
一股无形的力量瞬间将顾铮周围的空间禁锢，仿佛有一只看不见的巨手将他攥在了掌心之中！
这一抓，足以将一名混元境高手捏成肉泥！
然而，就在龙君即将握紧拳头的瞬间，顾铮消失了。
他就那样凭空消失在了原地，仿佛从未存在过一般。没有残影，没有遁光，没有任何真气波动的痕迹，就那么干干净净地消失了。
龙君的一抓落了空，那股无形的力量将顾铮原先站立位置后方的地面捏出一个巨大的凹陷，碎石飞溅，尘土飞扬。
但龙君的表情却第一次出现了真正的错愕，他抓空了？他明明已经锁定了顾铮的气息，怎么可能抓空？
而下一瞬，龙君的瞳孔骤然收缩。
长空之中，一道身影凭空出现，顾铮出现在龙君头顶上方数十丈的位置，手中长刀裹挟着紫色的雷电，如同一道天罚般凌空斩落！
content_en:
"He actually injured Mr. Long?"
At this moment, everyone was stunned.
Those guests who were still mocking Gu Zheng for not overestimating his abilities now opened their mouths wide and couldn't close them for a long time. Those who shook their heads and sighed, convinced that Gu Zheng would definitely die, now looked at each other with disbelief in their eyes.
Even Ao Yanxi and his party were in disbelief.
Qing Qing covered her mouth, Aunt Hu frowned, Lin Wen and Lin Wu looked at each other, both seeing shock in each other's eyes. Ao Yu swallowed even more, and a layer of cold sweat broke out on his back. He remembered the pitiful pride he had when he and Gu Zheng were sparring. If Gu Zheng had used this move at that time, he might not even have ashes left now.
"In this battle, Gu Zheng is still honored even though he is defeated..." someone murmured in a low voice.
The strength gap between the two sides is there.
One is a dragon who is about to transform into a dragon, and the other is a human being who has not even reached the Hunyuan realm. .
Being able to hurt Lord Long to this extent is enough to make people all over the world look at this young man with admiration.
However, just when everyone thought that this battle would end with Gu Zheng's "defeat, glory",
Ang! ! !
A painful dragon roar resounded between heaven and earth, causing the entire Baibo Lake to boil!
The Dragon Lord looked up to the sky and roared, his voice filled with anger, excitement, and a rage that had been suppressed for too long and was finally about to be released!
"Gu Zheng!!! You are very good!!!" Long Jun lowered his head and stared at Gu Zheng with burning eyes, his voice was like thunder, "It's a pity that you can't beat me!!!"
He moved.
This is the first time Long Jun takes the initiative in this battle.
He took one step forward, and the entire square trembled and cracked under his feet, and an overwhelming pressure rushed toward Gu Zheng!
Everyone knows that once Lord Long becomes serious, there will be no suspense in this battle.
The agreement between the two parties was that Gu Zheng would last for a stick of incense under his hands, but now, less than a tenth of it had passed.
Everyone believed that as long as Long Jun took action, Gu Zheng would definitely be defeated.
"Gu Zheng!!" Ao Yanxi couldn't help shouting, with unconcealable anxiety in her voice.
However, Gu Zheng's calm voice sounded in her ears, as calm as if he was just stating a trivial matter: "Don't worry."
Long Jun took action.
His five fingers turned into claws and he grasped the air towards Gu Zheng!
An invisible force instantly imprisoned the space around Gu Zheng, as if an invisible giant hand was holding him in its palm!
This grab is enough to crush a Hunyuan realm master into a pulp!
However, just when Long Jun was about to clench his fist, Gu Zheng disappeared.
He just disappeared out of thin air, as if he had never existed. There was no afterimage, no escaping light, and no trace of any energy fluctuations. It just disappeared so cleanly.
Long Jun's grasp missed, and the invisible force created a huge depression in the ground behind where Gu Zheng originally stood, causing gravel to fly and dust to fly.
But for the first time, Long Jun's expression showed genuine astonishment. Was he wrong? He had clearly locked onto Gu Zheng's aura, how could he miss it?
And the next moment, Long Jun's pupils suddenly shrank.
In the sky, a figure appeared out of thin air. Gu Zheng appeared dozens of feet above Long Jun's head. The long knife in his hand was wrapped with purple thunder and lightning, and it fell in the air like a celestial punishment!
